packageRules.description: The Cilium module IS the policy spec cf2cnp supports: a bump is a release. The embedded CRD follows the module: run `go generate ./internal/crd` on the bump and commit it. Hosted Renovate (the Mend GitHub App) does NOT run postUpgradeTasks — they run on a self-hosted Renovate only, and only when the command is on its allowedCommands — so CI is the guard: TestEmbeddedCRDVersionMatchesModule and the byte-for-byte cmp fail the PR until the copy is refreshed.
packageRules.groupName: cilium policy API (the supported CiliumNetworkPolicy spec)
